summary.text: Mark Hackett is the Constitution Party candidate for U.S. Senate in South Carolina. He has run for U.S. House as the party's nominee in 2020 and 2024 and is making his first statewide run in 2026. Little biographical information about him is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Ran as the Constitution Party candidate for South Carolina's 6th Congressional District in 2020, receiving 0.9% (2,646 votes) in the general election won by James Clyburn.

Won the Constitution Party convention vote (8 to 5) on April 13, 2024 and ran in South Carolina's 4th Congressional District, receiving 2.8% (9,779 votes) in the general election won by William Timmons.
Is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for U.S. Senate as the Constitution Party candidate.
